name: plc-programming
description: PLC programming across IEC 61131-3 (ST, LD, FBD, SFC, IL), PLCopen XML / IEC 61131-10, Siemens TIA (SCL, SimaticML, SIMATIC SD), Schneider (Machine Expert, Control Expert), CODESYS, TwinCAT, ABB Freelance, Rockwell L5X/L5K, IEC 61499, AutomationML, DEXPI, PackML/ISA-88 and OPC UA: design, write, convert, review and debug programs, with a stdlib-only structural validator.
